title: Soat, kun tartibi va vaqt
goal_uz: Dars oxirida soatni so‘raysiz va aytasiz, vaqt bilan at, kun qismlari bilan in the ni to‘g‘ri ishlatasiz hamda kundalik ishlaringizni vaqtlari bilan kamida oltita gapda aytib berasiz.

scenes.title: Yettinchi darsga xush kelibsiz
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Yettinchi darsga xush kelibsiz. Oldingi darsda kasblar va ish joylari haqida gapirdik. Bugun yana bir juda foydali mavzu: vaqt. Soatni so‘rashni va aytishni, kun qismlarini, “at” bilan vaqtni ifodalashni va kundalik ishlarni o‘rganamiz. Dars oxirida ingliz tilida kuningiz qanday o‘tishini vaqtlari bilan aytib bera olasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome! Today we learn the time and how to talk about a day.
scenes.say_uz: Xush kelibsiz! Bugun vaqtni va kun tartibini ayta olishni o‘rganamiz.

scenes.title: What time is it?
scenes.say_native: Soatni so‘rash uchun “What time is it?” deymiz. O‘zbekchada “Soat necha?” Javob “It’s” bilan boshlanadi: “It’s three o’clock” — soat uch. Bu yerda “it” shaxsni emas, vaqtni bildiradi, o‘zbekchada esa bu gapda ega ko‘rinmaydi. “O’clock” faqat to‘liq soat uchun ishlatiladi. Suhbatda “o’clock” ni tushirib, shunchaki “It’s seven” deyish ham mumkin. Foydali narsa.
scenes.say: What time is it? It's three o'clock. It's seven.
scenes.say_uz: Soat necha? Soat uch. Soat yetti.

scenes.title: To‘liq soatlar
scenes.say_native: Soatlar birdan o‘n ikkigacha: one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten, eleven, twelve. Inglizcha soat o‘n ikkilik tizimda aytiladi. O‘zbekchada ba’zan o‘n uch, o‘n to‘rt deymiz, inglizchada kundalik nutqda bunday emas, o‘n ikkidan keyin yana bir, ikki boshlanadi. Shuning uchun soat o‘n beshni “three in the afternoon” deymiz. Buni bir ozdan keyin batafsil ko‘ramiz.
scenes.say: It's one. It's two. It's three. It's eight o'clock. It's twelve o'clock.
scenes.say_uz: Soat bir. Soat ikki. Soat uch. Soat sakkiz. Soat o‘n ikki.

scenes.title: Soatni ayting
scenes.say_native: Soat necha? To‘rtta vaqtni inglizcha ayting. Birinchi: uch. Ikkinchi: sakkiz. Uchinchi: o‘n bir. To‘rtinchi: o‘n ikki. Har bir javobni “It’s” bilan boshlang va xohlasangiz “o’clock” qo‘shing. Masalan, “It’s three o’clock.” Shoshilmang, har bir sonni aniq va ravshan talaffuz qiling, chunki keyingi mashqlarda murakkabroq vaqtlar bor.
scenes.say: Three. Eight. Eleven. Twelve.
scenes.say_uz: Uch. Sakkiz. O‘n bir. O‘n ikki.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: “It’s three o’clock”. “It’s eight o’clock”. “It’s eleven o’clock”. “It’s twelve o’clock”. Hammasi bir xil tuzilgan: “It’s”, raqam, “o’clock”. Agar to‘g‘ri aytgan bo‘lsangiz, eng oddiy qadam tamom. Endi murakkabroq vaqtlarga o‘tamiz: yarim, chorak va daqiqalar.
scenes.say: It's three o'clock. It's eight o'clock. It's eleven o'clock. It's twelve o'clock.
scenes.say_uz: Soat uch. Soat sakkiz. Soat o‘n bir. Soat o‘n ikki.

scenes.title: Yarim va chorak
scenes.say_native: Yarim soat uchun “half past” deymiz: “half past seven” — soat yetti yarim. Chorak soat o‘tgan bo‘lsa “quarter past”: “quarter past seven” — yetti o‘tib o‘n besh daqiqa. Soatga o‘n besh daqiqa qolgan bo‘lsa “quarter to”: “quarter to eight” — sakkizga chorak qoldi. O‘zbekcha “sakkizga chorak qoldi” deganimiz ham xuddi shu ma’no. Faqat so‘zlarning tartibi bir oz boshqacha: avval “quarter”, keyin “to” va keyingi soat.
scenes.say: Half past seven. Quarter past seven. Quarter to eight.
scenes.say_uz: Yetti yarim. Yetti o‘tib chorak. Sakkizga chorak qoldi.

scenes.title: Daqiqalar: past va to
scenes.say_native: Daqiqalar uchun ikki so‘z kerak: “past” va “to”. Yarim soatgacha “past” ishlatamiz: “ten past three” — 3:10. Yarim soatdan keyin “to”: “twenty to four” — to‘rtga yigirma daqiqa qoldi, ya’ni 3:40. Qoidani eslab qoling: soat strelkasi yarimgacha bo‘lsa — “past”, yarimdan o‘tsa — “to”. “To” dan keyin keyingi soat aytiladi, chunki biz shu soatga qancha qolganini aytyapmiz.
scenes.say: Ten past three. Twenty past three. Twenty to four. Five to four.
scenes.say_uz: Uchdan o‘n o‘tdi. Uchdan yigirma o‘tdi. To‘rtga yigirma qoldi. To‘rtga besh qoldi.

scenes.title: Raqamli usul

examples.t: The train is at nine fifteen.

scenes.say_native: Vaqtni ikkinchi, oddiyroq usulda ham aytish mumkin: soat va daqiqani ketma-ket o‘qiymiz. Yetti o‘ttiz — “seven thirty”. Yetti qirq besh — “seven forty-five”. O‘n yigirma — “ten twenty”. Agar daqiqa bir xonali bo‘lsa, “oh” deymiz: “seven oh five” — 7:05. Poyezd, avtobus yoki dars jadvalini aytganda aynan shu usul keng qo‘llanadi. Buni yodlab oling, chunki yozma ravishda ham shunday ko‘rinadi.
scenes.say: Seven oh five. Seven thirty. Seven forty-five. Ten twenty.
scenes.say_uz: Yetti nol besh. Yetti o‘ttiz. Yetti qirq besh. O‘n yigirma.

scenes.title: O’clock faqat to‘liq soatda
scenes.say_native: Eng ko‘p uchraydigan xato — “o’clock” ni daqiqa bilan birga ishlatish. “Seven o’clock thirty” — xato, chunki “o’clock” faqat ayni soat boshlanganda ishlatiladi. Ikkinchi xato — “past” ni tushirib qoldirish: “half seven” o‘zbek tilidagi “yetti yarim” ga o‘xshab ketadi. Aslida Britaniyada og‘zaki nutqda “half seven” ham yetti o‘ttiz degani, lekin o‘rganish uchun to‘liq shaklni ishlating: “half past seven”.
scenes.say: It's half past seven. It's seven thirty. O'clock is only for full hours.
scenes.say_uz: Soat yetti yarim. Soat yetti o‘ttiz. O’clock faqat to‘liq soat uchun.

scenes.title: Vaqtlarni ayting
scenes.say_native: Beshta vaqt. Har birini ingliz tilida ayting. To‘rt o‘n besh. Olti o‘ttiz. To‘qqiz qirq besh. O‘n o‘n. Ikki ellik. “Past” va “to” dan foydalaning va qaysi soatni aytishni unutmang. Avval quloq bilan chamalang: yarimgacha bo‘lsa — past, undan keyin — to.
scenes.say: Four fifteen. Six thirty. Nine forty-five. Ten ten. Two fifty.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt o‘n besh. Olti o‘ttiz. To‘qqiz qirq besh. O‘n o‘n. Ikki ellik.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. 4:15 — “quarter past four”. 6:30 — “half past six”. 9:45 — “quarter to ten”, chunki o‘nga o‘n besh daqiqa qoldi. 10:10 — “ten past ten”. 2:50 — “ten to three”, uchga o‘n daqiqa qoldi. Raqamli usulda ham to‘g‘ri: “four fifteen”, “six thirty”, “nine forty-five”, “ten ten”, “two fifty”. Ikkala usul ham to‘g‘ri, o‘zingizga qulayini tanlang.
scenes.say: Quarter past four. Half past six. Quarter to ten. Ten past ten. Ten to three.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rtdan chorak o‘tdi. Olti yarim. O‘nga chorak qoldi. O‘ndan o‘n o‘tdi. Uchga o‘n qoldi.

scenes.title: a.m., p.m., noon, midnight
scenes.say_native: O‘zbekchada ko‘pincha o‘n to‘rt, o‘n besh, yigirma soat deymiz. Inglizchada kundalik nutqda o‘n ikkilik tizim ishlatiladi. Ertalabdan tushgacha — “a.m.”, tushdan keyin kechgacha — “p.m.”. Shuning uchun soat 15:00 — “3 p.m.”. “Noon” — kunduzi soat o‘n ikki, “midnight” — tungi soat o‘n ikki. Poyezd va samolyot jadvalida esa 24 soatlik yozuv ham uchraydi, ammo og‘zaki nutqda baribir “three p.m.” deyiladi.
scenes.say: Seven a.m. Three p.m. Noon. Midnight.
scenes.say_uz: Ertalab yetti. Tushdan keyin uch. Tush. Yarim tun.

scenes.title: Kun qismlari
scenes.say_native: Kun to‘rt qismga bo‘linadi: “morning” — ertalab, “afternoon” — tushdan keyin, “evening” — kechqurun, “night” — tun. Birinchi darsda “Good morning” va “Good evening” ni o‘rgangan edingiz. Bu so‘zlarning oldida “in the” keladi: “in the morning”, “in the afternoon”, “in the evening”. Faqat “night” istisno: “at night”. Bu bir qoida emas, balki yodlanadigan ibora, shuning uchun uni alohida eslab qoling.
scenes.say: In the morning. In the afternoon. In the evening. At night.
scenes.say_uz: Ertalab. Tushdan keyin. Kechqurun. Kechasi.

scenes.title: In yoki at?
scenes.say_native: Yuklamalarni aralashtirish — eng keng tarqalgan xato. “At the morning” emas, “in the morning”. “In night” emas, “at night”. Sababi shuki, ingliz tilida ertalab, tushdan keyin va kechqurunni vaqt oralig‘i deb tasavvur qilamiz, shuning uchun “in”. Tun esa bir nuqta kabi, shuning uchun “at”. O‘zbekchada bu farq yo‘q: “ertalab”, “kechasi” — hammasi bitta shaklda. Inglizchada esa ularni yodlab olish kerak.
scenes.say: In the morning. At night. Not at the morning. Not in night.
scenes.say_uz: In the morning. At night. At the morning emas. In night emas.

scenes.title: In yoki at?
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta ibora. Har birining oldiga “in” yoki “at” ni qo‘ying. Tushdan keyin. Kechasi. Tush paytida. Kechqurun. Butun iborani baland ovozda ayting. Eslatma: “noon” bilan ham “at” kerak, chunki u aniq bir lahza. Oldingi sahnadagi qoidani eslang: ertalab, tushdan keyin va kechqurun bilan “in the”, faqat tun bilan “at”.
scenes.say: Afternoon. Night. Noon. Evening.
scenes.say_uz: Tushdan keyin. Kechasi. Tush. Kechqurun.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. “In the afternoon”. “At night”. “At noon”. “In the evening”. Bu to‘rtta iborani butunlay yodlab olsangiz, ular har kuni kerak bo‘ladi. “Noon” — aniq vaqt, shuning uchun “at”. “Midnight” bilan ham “at” ishlatiladi: “at midnight”. Qolgan kun qismlarida esa “in the” bor.
scenes.say: In the afternoon. At night. At noon. In the evening.
scenes.say_uz: Tushdan keyin. Kechasi. Tushda. Kechqurun.

scenes.title: At + vaqt

examples.t: We have lunch at half past twelve.
examples.uz: Biz soat o‘n ikki yarimda tushlik qilamiz.

scenes.say_native: O‘zbekchada aniq vaqt uchun “-da” qo‘shimchasini ishlatamiz: soat yettida, soat sakkiz yarimda. Inglizchada bunga “at” to‘g‘ri keladi. “At seven o’clock”, “at half past six”, “at 8:30”. Muhim farq: o‘zbekchada qo‘shimcha so‘zdan keyin keladi, inglizchada esa “at” oldin turadi. Va “soat” so‘zi kerak emas: “at seven”, ya’ni “at seven hours” deyilmaydi.
scenes.say: At seven o'clock. At half past six. At eight thirty.
scenes.say_uz: Soat yettida. Olti yarimda. Sakkiz o‘ttizda.

scenes.title: Vaqt bilan in ishlatish
scenes.say_native: Aniq vaqt bilan faqat “at” ishlatiladi. “In seven o’clock” — xato. Bu xato o‘zbekcha “-da” ni inglizchada “in” deb tarjima qilishdan kelib chiqadi. Ikkinchi xato — “hours” qo‘shish: o‘zbekchada “soat yetti” deyiladi, shuning uchun inglizchaga ham “seven hours” deb ko‘chirishadi. Bunday bo‘lmaydi. Vaqtni aytayotganda “hours” ishlatilmaydi. “Hour” faqat davomiylikni bildiradi, bu haqida keyingi darslarda gaplashamiz.
scenes.say: At seven o'clock. At seven. Not in seven. Not at seven hours.
scenes.say_uz: Soat yettida. Soat yettida. In seven emas. At seven hours emas.

scenes.title: O‘zbekchadan inglizchaga
scenes.say_native: O‘zbekcha iboralarni inglizchaga o‘giring. Birinchi: soat yettida. Ikkinchi: soat sakkiz yarimda. Uchinchi: tushda. To‘rtinchi: kechasi. Har biri “at” yoki “in” bilan boshlanadi. Avval qaysi yuklama kerakligini o‘ylang. “Soat yettida” va “soat sakkiz yarimda” — bular aniq vaqt, “tushda” va “kechasi” esa kun qismlari. Har bir iborani butunlay ayting.
scenes.say: At seven. At half past eight. At noon. At night.
scenes.say_uz: Soat yettida. Sakkiz yarimda. Tushda. Kechasi.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: “at seven”, “at half past eight”, “at noon”, “at night”. To‘rttalasida “at”, chunki to‘rttalasi ham aniq bir lahza. “Kechasi” — qiziq istisno, uni esdan chiqarmang. Endi navbat talaffuzga. Raqamlar bilan bog‘liq bitta muhim tafsilot bor, uni bilmaslik tushunmovchilikka olib keladi.
scenes.say: At seven. At half past eight. At noon. At night.
scenes.say_uz: Soat yettida. Sakkiz yarimda. Tushda. Kechasi.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: thirteen va thirty
scenes.say_native: Inglizchada “-teen” bilan tugaydigan sonlar bilan “-ty” bilan tugaydigan sonlar o‘xshab ketadi. O‘n uch — “thirTEEN”, urg‘u oxirgi bo‘g‘inda, tovush cho‘ziq. O‘ttiz — “THIRty”, urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda, oxiri yengil. O‘n besh — “fifTEEN”, ellik — “FIFty”. Vaqtni aytganda bu farq juda muhim: o‘n besh va ellik daqiqa butunlay boshqa narsa. Shuning uchun “-teen” da ovozni cho‘zing, “-ty” da esa qisqa ayting.
scenes.say: Thirteen. Thirty. Fifteen. Fifty.
scenes.say_uz: O‘n uch. O‘ttiz. O‘n besh. Ellik.

scenes.title: Takrorlang
scenes.say_native: Juftliklarni takrorlang. Thirteen, thirty. Fourteen, forty. Fifteen, fifty. “-teen” da urg‘u va cho‘ziq tovush, “-ty” da urg‘u boshida. Har juftlikni ikki marta ayting. Farqni o‘zingiz eshiting. Birinchi so‘zda ovozingiz oxirida cho‘zilsin, ikkinchisida esa boshida kuchli, oxirida qisqa bo‘lsin. Agar mumkin bo‘lsa, ovozingizni yozib oling.
scenes.say: Thirteen. Thirty. Fourteen. Forty. Fifteen. Fifty.
scenes.say_uz: O‘n uch. O‘ttiz. O‘n to‘rt. Qirq. O‘n besh. Ellik.

scenes.title: Takrorlash natijasi
scenes.say_native: Yaxshi. Eslatma: agar ikkala so‘z sizda bir xil eshitilsa, “-teen” ni ataylab cho‘zib ayting, “-ty” ni esa qisqa. Suhbatdoshingiz tez tushunadi. Vaqtni aytayotganda sonlarni aniq talaffuz qilish eng muhimi, chunki xato eshitilgan son butun ma’noni o‘zgartirib yuboradi. Endi dars mavzusining ikkinchi qismiga o‘tamiz: kundalik ishlar va ularni ifodalovchi fe’llar.
scenes.say: Long teen. Short ty. Listen for the stress.
scenes.say_uz: Uzun teen. Qisqa ty. Urg‘uga quloq soling.

scenes.title: Kundalik fe’llar: ertalab
board: have a shower — dush qabul qilmoq
scenes.say_native: Kunning birinchi yarmi uchun fe’llar. “Get up” — o‘rnidan turish. “Have a shower” — dush qabul qilish. “Have breakfast” — nonushta qilish. “Go to work” — ishga borish. Diqqat: “have” bu yerda “ega bo‘lmoq” emas, “qilmoq, yemoq, ichmoq” ma’nosida. Nonushta, tushlik, kechki ovqat bilan doim “have” ishlatamiz. “Eat breakfast” ham to‘g‘ri, lekin “have breakfast” tabiiyroq eshitiladi.
scenes.say: I get up at six. I have a shower. I have breakfast at seven. I go to work at eight.
scenes.say_uz: Men oltida turaman. Dush qabul qilaman. Yettida nonushta qilaman. Sakkizda ishga ketaman.

scenes.title: Kundalik fe’llar: kunduzi
scenes.say_native: Kunduzgi ishlar. “Start work” — ishni boshlamoq. “Have lunch” — tushlik qilmoq. “Finish work” — ishni tugatmoq. “Come home” — uyga kelmoq. “Go home” ham bor: “go home” — uyga ketmoq. Farqi harakat yo‘nalishida: “come” — kelmoq, “go” — bormoq yoki ketmoq. Eslab qoling: “home” oldida “to” ishlatilmaydi. “Go to home” deb aytmang. Bu xatoni keyinroq alohida ko‘rib chiqamiz.
scenes.say: I start work at nine. I have lunch at one. I finish work at five. I come home at six.
scenes.say_uz: Men to‘qqizda ishni boshlayman. Birda tushlik qilaman. Beshda ishni tugataman. Oltida uyga kelaman.

scenes.title: Kundalik fe’llar: kechqurun

examples.t: I go to bed at eleven.

scenes.say_native: Kun oxiri uchun fe’llar. “Have dinner” — kechki ovqat qilish. “Watch TV” — televizor ko‘rish. “Go to bed” — yotish. “Sleep” — uxlash. “Go to bed” va “sleep” farqini biling. “Go to bed” — yotish harakati, ya’ni yotoqqa borish. “Sleep” — uxlash jarayoni. “I go to bed at eleven” va “I sleep for seven hours”. Birinchisida vaqt nuqta, ikkinchisida davomiylik.
scenes.say: I have dinner at seven. I watch TV. I go to bed at eleven.
scenes.say_uz: Men yettida kechki ovqat yeyman. Televizor ko‘raman. O‘n birda yotaman.

scenes.title: Tartibga soling
scenes.say_native: Kundalik ishlar aralash berilgan: yotmoq, turmoq, tushlik qilmoq, nonushta qilmoq, uyga kelmoq. Ularni kun tartibiga qo‘ying: birinchi nima bo‘ladi, oxirgi nima. Har birini “I” bilan boshlab, to‘liq gap qiling. Masalan, “I get up”. Hozircha vaqt aytish shart emas, faqat to‘g‘ri tartib va to‘g‘ri fe’l iboralari kerak. Dush, uyga kelish va yotish iboralarini oldingi sahnalardan eslang.
scenes.say: Go to bed. Get up. Have lunch. Have breakfast. Come home.
scenes.say_uz: Yotmoq. Turmoq. Tushlik qilmoq. Nonushta qilmoq. Uyga kelmoq.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: To‘g‘ri tartib: avval “I get up”. Keyin “I have breakfast”. Keyin “I have lunch”. Keyin “I come home”. Eng oxirida “I go to bed”. Tartibni so‘zlar bilan bog‘lash uchun “then” — keyin, va “after that” — undan keyin degan so‘zlarni ham ishlatishingiz mumkin. Ularni bir oz keyinroq ko‘ramiz.
scenes.say: I get up. I have breakfast. I have lunch. I come home. I go to bed.
scenes.say_uz: Men turaman. Nonushta qilaman. Tushlik qilaman. Uyga kelaman. Yotaman.

scenes.title: What time do you …?
board: What time do you get up?
What time do you go to bed?
I go to bed at eleven.

examples.t: What time do you have lunch?

scenes.say_native: Kun tartibi haqida so‘rash uchun “What time do you …?” deymiz. “What time do you get up?” — soat nechada turasiz? Javob oddiy: “I get up at six.” Savol tuzilishi: “What time”, “do you”, fe’l. Javob: “I”, fe’l, “at” va vaqt. O‘zbekchada bu savolni “soat nechada” deymiz, inglizchada ham “what time” so‘zlari tushadi, “at” savolda kerak emas, lekin javobda albatta bor.
scenes.say: What time do you get up? I get up at six. What time do you go to bed? I go to bed at eleven.
scenes.say_uz: Soat nechada turasiz? Men oltida turaman. Soat nechada yotasiz? Men o‘n birda yotaman.

scenes.title: Fe’llar bilan xatolar
board: ✓ I go home. I go to bed. I have breakfast.
scenes.say_native: Uchta tipik xato. Birinchisi: “go to home”. Inglizchada “home” oldida “to” ishlatilmaydi: “go home”. Ikkinchisi: “go to the bed”. Yotmoq — “go to bed”, artiklsiz. Uchinchisi: “do breakfast”. O‘zbekcha “nonushta qilmoq” so‘zma-so‘z “do” bo‘lib ketadi, lekin inglizchada “have breakfast” deyiladi. Dush ham xuddi shunday: “have a shower”. Bu birikmalar o‘z holicha yodlanadi.
scenes.say: I go home. I go to bed. I have breakfast. I have a shower.
scenes.say_uz: Men uyga ketaman. Men yotaman. Men nonushta qilaman. Men dush qabul qilaman.

scenes.title: Kun tartibini gapiring
scenes.say_native: Berilgan vaqtlar bilan to‘rtta gap tuzing. 6:30 da turasiz. 7:15 da nonushta qilasiz. 8:00 da ishga borasiz. Kechqurun soat o‘nda yotasiz. Har bir gapni “I”, fe’l, “at” va vaqt bilan ayting. Vaqtni “half past”, “quarter past” bilan ham ayting. Har bir gapda “at” bo‘lishi shart, shuning uchun uni tushirib qoldirmang. Kechqurun vaqtini “p.m.” bilan tugatsangiz ham bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: I get up at half past six. I have breakfast at quarter past seven. I go to work at eight. I go to bed at ten p.m.
scenes.say_uz: Men olti yarimda turaman. Yettidan chorak o‘tganda nonushta qilaman. Sakkizda ishga ketaman. Kechqurun o‘nda yotaman.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: I get up at half past six.
I have breakfast at quarter past seven.
I go to work at eight.
I go to bed at ten p.m.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: “I get up at half past six”. “I have breakfast at quarter past seven”. “I go to work at eight”. “I go to bed at ten p.m.” Raqamli usul ham to‘g‘ri: “I get up at six thirty”, “I have breakfast at seven fifteen”. E’tibor bering, har bir gapda “at” va fe’l turibdi, “I” esa o‘zgarmaydi. Endi bularning hammasini haqiqiy dialogda eshitamiz.
scenes.say: I get up at half past six. I have breakfast at quarter past seven. I go to work at eight. I go to bed at ten p.m.
scenes.say_uz: Men olti yarimda turaman. Yettidan chorak o‘tganda nonushta qilaman. Sakkizda ishga ketaman. Kechqurun o‘nda yotaman.

scenes.title: Dialog: ko‘chada
board: Tom: Excuse me, what time is it?
Tom: Oh no! My class is at nine.
Anna: Don’t worry. The school is near.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi tinglash dialogi. Ko‘chada Tom o‘tgan odamdan soatni so‘rayapti. “Excuse me” — kechirasiz, notanish odamga murojaat qilishning odobli usuli. Tom darsga kech qolayotganidan xavotirda. Tinglang: soat necha, dars soat nechada va maktab uzoqmi. Keyin uchta savolga javob berasiz.
scenes.say: Excuse me, what time is it? It's twenty to nine. Oh no! My class is at nine. Don't worry. The school is near. Thank you!
scenes.say_uz: Kechirasiz, soat necha? Soat to‘qqizga yigirma daqiqa qoldi. Voy! Mening darsim to‘qqizda. Xavotir olmang. Maktab yaqin. Rahmat!

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: soat necha? Ikkinchi: Tomning darsi soat nechada? Uchinchi: maktab uzoqmi? Birinchi javobni raqamli usulda ham ayting. Uchinchisiga “Yes” yoki “No” bilan boshlab javob bering. Dialogni eslab ko‘ring: Anna maktab yaqin degan edi. Shoshilmang, avval javobni ichingizda tuzing, keyin ovoz chiqarib ayting.
scenes.say: What time is it? What time is Tom's class? Is the school far?
scenes.say_uz: Soat necha? Tomning darsi soat nechada? Maktab uzoqmi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Soat necha? “It’s twenty to nine”, ya’ni 8:40. Tomning darsi soat nechada? “At nine.” Maktab uzoqmi? “No, it isn’t. It’s near.” Esingizdami, o‘tgan darsda “to be” savolini qisqa javob bilan berishni o‘rgandik. Bu yerda ham xuddi shunday. 8:40 ni “eight forty” deb ham aytishingiz mumkin.
scenes.say: It's twenty to nine. At nine. No, it isn't. It's near.
scenes.say_uz: Soat to‘qqizga yigirma daqiqa qoldi. To‘qqizda. Yo‘q, uzoq emas. Yaqin.

scenes.title: Dialog: hamshiraning kuni
board: Q: What time do you get up, Maria?
Maria: I get up at six. I have breakfast at half past six.
Maria: I go to work at seven and I start at eight.
Maria: I finish at five. I go to bed at ten.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog — intervyu. Jurnalist Mariyadan uning kuni qanday o‘tishini so‘raydi. Mariya hamshira. Tinglang va vaqtlarni eslab qoling. U soat nechada turadi, qachon nonushta qiladi, qachon ishni boshlaydi va qachon yotadi. Dialogda har xil vaqt bor, shuning uchun diqqat bilan tinglang.
scenes.say: What time do you get up, Maria? I get up at six. I have breakfast at half past six. I go to work at seven and I start at eight. I finish at five. I go to bed at ten.
scenes.say_uz: Mariya, soat nechada turasiz? Men oltida turaman. Olti yarimda nonushta qilaman. Yettida ishga ketaman va sakkizda boshlayman. Beshda tugataman. O‘nda yotaman.

scenes.title: Savollar
board: 1) What time does Maria get up?
3) What time does she go to bed?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Mariya soat nechada turadi? U ishni qachon boshlaydi? Soat nechada yotadi? Savollarda “does” bor, bu “do” ning “she” bilan shakli. Javob uchun “She” bilan boshlang va fe’lga “s” qo‘shing. Masalan: “She gets up at…”. Keyingi darslarda batafsil o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: What time does Maria get up? When does she start work? What time does she go to bed?
scenes.say_uz: Mariya soat nechada turadi? U ishni qachon boshlaydi? Soat nechada yotadi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 3) She goes to bed at ten.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Mariya oltida turadi — “She gets up at six”. Ishni sakkizda boshlaydi — “She starts work at eight”. O‘nda yotadi — “She goes to bed at ten”. Fe’llardagi “s” ga e’tibor bering: gets, starts, goes. Bu uchinchi shaxs qoidasi, hozir uni ongli ravishda yodlash shart emas. Keyingi darsda, ya’ni sakkizinchi darsda, uni to‘liq o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: She gets up at six. She starts work at eight. She goes to bed at ten.
scenes.say_uz: U oltida turadi. U ishni sakkizda boshlaydi. U o‘nda yotadi.

scenes.title: Then va after that
board: After that, I go to work.
In the evening, I watch TV.

examples.t: I get up at six. Then I have a shower.
examples.uz: Men oltida turaman. Keyin dush qabul qilaman.

examples.t: After that, I go to work.

scenes.say_native: Kun tartibini ketma-ket aytganda gaplarni bog‘lovchi so‘zlar kerak. “First” — avval. “Then” — keyin. “After that” — undan keyin. “In the evening” — kechqurun. Shunda nutqingiz bir qator alohida gaplar emas, balki bir butun hikoyaga o‘xshaydi. Masalan: “I get up at six. Then I have breakfast. After that, I go to work.” Bu o‘zbekchadagi “keyin”, “undan so‘ng” ga to‘g‘ri keladi.
scenes.say: First, I get up. Then I have breakfast. After that, I go to work.
scenes.say_uz: Avval turaman. Keyin nonushta qilaman. Undan keyin ishga ketaman.

scenes.title: Tabiiy nutq: bog‘lanish
scenes.say_native: Tezroq gapirganda inglizlar so‘zlarni bog‘lab aytadi. “Get up” — “ge-tup”, oxirgi undosh keyingi unli bilan qo‘shilib ketadi. “What time” da “t” keyingi so‘zga yopishadi. “Go to bed” da “to” juda yengil, “tə” kabi. “At” ham gap ichida yengil, “ət” deb eshitiladi: “I get up at six” — “ge-tup ət six”. Siz ham shunday ayting, shunda tabiiy chiqadi.
scenes.say: I get up at six. What time is it? I go to bed.
scenes.say_uz: Men oltida turaman. Soat necha? Men yotaman.

scenes.title: Sizning kuningiz
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingizning kuningizni ayting. Kamida oltita vaqt ishlating. Masalan: “I get up at six thirty. I have breakfast at seven. I go to work at eight. I have lunch at one. I come home at six. I go to bed at eleven.” Sizning vaqtlaringiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin. Vaqtni “at” bilan ayting va gaplarni “then” bilan bog‘lang.
scenes.say: Tell me about your day. Use at least six times.
scenes.say_uz: O‘z kuningiz haqida ayting. Kamida oltita vaqtdan foydalaning.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: I get up at six thirty.
I go to work at eight.
I go to bed at eleven.
scenes.say_native: Namuna. “I get up at six thirty. Then I have breakfast at seven. I go to work at eight. I have lunch at one. After that, I come home at six. I have dinner at seven. I go to bed at eleven.” Sizniki boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin. Asosiysi: har bir vaqt oldida “at”, har bir fe’l “I” dan keyin, gaplar “then” va “after that” bilan bog‘langan. Shunday qilsangiz, bugungi maqsadga yetdingiz.
scenes.say: I get up at six thirty. Then I have breakfast at seven. I go to work at eight. I go to bed at eleven.
scenes.say_uz: Men olti o‘ttizda turaman. Keyin yettida nonushta qilaman. Sakkizda ishga ketaman. O‘n birda yotaman.

scenes.title: Qisqacha takrorlaymiz
board: What time is it? → It’s half past seven.
at + time · in the morning · at night
get up · have breakfast · go to work · go to bed
scenes.say_native: Bugungi darsni eslaymiz. Birinchi: “What time is it?” — va to‘liq soat, yarim, chorak, past va to. Ikkinchi: kun qismlari va yuklamalar, “in the morning”, “at night”. Uchinchi: aniq vaqt bilan “at”. To‘rtinchi: kundalik fe’llar, “get up”, “have breakfast”, “go to work”, “go to bed”. Beshinchi: “What time do you get up?” savoli va javobi. Oltinchi: “-teen” va “-ty” talaffuzi.
scenes.say: Today you learned how to tell the time, use at, and talk about a daily routine.
scenes.say_uz: Bugun siz vaqtni aytishni, at ni ishlatishni va kun tartibi haqida gapirishni o‘rgandingiz.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: I get up at … Then I …
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi. Ish yoki o‘qish kuningizni ingliz tilida yozing yoki ayting. Kamida oltita soat vaqti bo‘lsin, har biri “at” bilan. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: oltita vaqt, to‘g‘ri yuklamalar va kamida bitta “then” yoki “after that”. Keyingi darsda hozirgi zamon: odatlar va kundalik ishlar haqida gaplashamiz va bugungi fe’llarni to‘liq qoidalar bilan o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Homework: describe your weekday with at least six clock times.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: ish kuningizni kamida oltita soat vaqti bilan tasvirlang.

homework_uz: Ish yoki o‘qish kuningizni ingliz tilida yozing yoki ayting: kamida oltita soat vaqti bo‘lsin (masalan: I get up at six thirty. Then I have breakfast at seven.). Har bir vaqt oldida at bo‘lsin va kamida bitta then yoki after that ishlating.

quiz.why_uz: Yarim soat uchun half past ishlatiladi. O’clock faqat to‘liq soatda.
4 ga o‘n besh daqiqa qoldi: quarter to four.
Noon aniq lahza, shuning uchun at noon.
Morning, afternoon, evening bilan in the; night bilan at.

options: I get up at six hours.
quiz.why_uz: Aniq vaqt bilan at ishlatiladi, hours kerak emas.

options: I go to home at six.
I go to the home at six.
quiz.why_uz: Home oldida to ishlatilmaydi: go home.

quiz.q: Which number has the stress at the end?
